name: 时间戳取证
description: Cross-references creation, modification, and digitized timestamps 以检测 temporal 异常 表明 AI generation or 篡改. Validates timestamp consistency 跨 multiple EXIF fields.
algorithm: 多时间戳交叉引用分析器
mechanism:
The timestamp 取证s 分析 performs comprehensive temporal validation:

1. **Multi-field Collection**: Gathers all available timestamp fields — DateTimeOriginal, CreateDate, DateTimeDigitized, ModifyDate, DateTime, GPSDateTime, SubSecTimeOriginal — providing a complete temporal picture.

2. **Temporal Consistency Analysis**: Validates logical ordering — DateTimeOriginal ≤ DateTimeDigitized ≤ ModifyDate. Violations indicate 元数据 篡改.

3. **Anomaly Detection**: 识别 future dates, epoch timestamps (1970-01-01), default values (0000:00:00), timezone 不一致, and suspiciously round timestamps (exactly on the hour).

4. **Time Span Analysis**: 测量 intervals 之间 capture events. Camera bursts show millisecond intervals, while fabricated timestamps show unusual gaps or identical values.

5. **SubSecond Precision**: 检查 for sub-second timing data (SubSecTimeOriginal), 其 is present in modern cameras but absent in most AI生成的 images.
parameters:
Timestamp fields: DateTimeOriginal, CreateDate, DateTimeDigitized, ModifyDate, DateTime, GPSDateTime, SubSecTimeOriginal
Formats: EXIF (YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS), ISO 8601
Anomaly 模式: epoch date, future date, identical timestamps, missing subsecond data
Expected ordering: Original ≤ Digitized ≤ Modified
accuracy: Medium-高 - 75-85%. Effective when multiple timestamps are present. Less reliable when only one timestamp exists.
useCase: Temporal 完整性 verification in 取证 pipelines. 检测 timestamp 篡改 in both AI生成的 and manually tampered images. Essential for establishing image chronology in legal contexts.
strengths:
• 多字段交叉引用检测不一致
• 亚秒数据是相机真实性的强指标
• 检测AI生成和手动篡改
• 时间排序验证高度可靠
• 与GPS时间戳配合额外验证
limitations:
• 相机时钟可能被用户设置错误
• 单个时间戳取证价值有限
• AI工具正在改进时间戳生成
• 时区处理因设备而异
• 批处理可能产生相同时间戳
